title: Marketing website for Mookie’s at Mugford (cozy modern café landing page)

requirements.text: Create a mobile-first, single-page marketing website for the coffee shop “Mookie’s at Mugford” using the provided business information exactly as written (name, address, phone, price range, hours, service options, dog friendly, rating/review count).

quotes: Build a **super clean, modern, visually irresistible website** for a coffee shop called **Mookie’s at Mugford**.

acceptanceCriteria: The landing page renders as a single scrollable page with clearly separated sections.
All business info strings appear exactly as provided (including punctuation like “Open · Closes 3 PM” and “⭐ 4.9 (108 reviews)”).
Layout is responsive and readable on mobile, tablet, and desktop.

requirements.text: Implement the specified page structure and content sections in this order: (1) Hero with headline “Your Favorite Local Coffee Spot.”, subheadline about coffee/pastries/friendly vibes, CTAs “View Menu” and “Order Online”, and visible ⭐ 4.9 rating; (2) About Mookie’s (warm, casual story mentioning community feel and dog-friendly); (3) Menu Highlights as clean cards with photos for Avocado Toast, Cinnamon Roll, Variety of Pastries, Ham, Egg & Cheese, Egg & Cheddar, Lattes & Espresso Drinks plus a “View Full Menu” button; (4) “Why People Love It” social-proof style bullets; (5) Reviews section with the three provided quotes, 5-star display, and total review count 108; (6) Visit Us with address, embedded map, hours, clickable phone number, and “Get Directions” button; (7) Footer with name/logo, address, phone, hours, and social icons (Instagram vibe).
acceptanceCriteria: Each section exists with the required headings/copy and is reachable by scrolling.
Hero shows the rating near the headline area and includes both CTAs.
Menu highlight items are displayed as cards and each card includes an image.
Reviews section shows the three quotes exactly as provided and displays 108 review count.
Visit Us includes an interactive map embed and a clickable phone link using tel:(781) 990-3282.
Footer includes social icons styled consistently (links may be placeholders if no URLs are provided).

requirements.text: Wire CTA behaviors with smooth scrolling and sensible fallbacks: “View Menu” scrolls to Menu Highlights; “View Full Menu” scrolls to Menu Highlights and/or expands an in-page full menu area (if implemented) without navigating away; “Get Directions” opens a maps directions URL targeting “114 Washington St, Marblehead, MA 01945”; “Order Online” opens an in-page modal or section explaining online ordering is not available yet and offers the clickable phone number to order by call.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking “View Menu” smoothly scrolls to the menu section.
Clicking “Get Directions” opens a new tab with directions for the exact address.
Clicking “Order Online” does not dead-end; it shows a modal/section with a clear next action (call link).
All interactive elements have accessible focus styles and keyboard support.

requirements.text: Apply the requested brand vibe and UX polish across the page: warm cozy modern café aesthetic; soft neutrals with accent colors espresso brown, cream, muted green; subtle animations and soft shadows; smooth scrolling; clean sans-serif typography; no clutter and no pop-ups.

quotes: * Accent colors: espresso brown, cream, muted green
* Smooth scroll, subtle animations, soft shadows

acceptanceCriteria: Visual styling matches the described palette and cozy café feel (neutrals + espresso/cream/muted green accents).
Animations are subtle (e.g., gentle fade/slide on scroll, hover elevation) and do not block interaction.
No modal dialogs appear automatically; the only modal allowed is user-triggered (e.g., Order Online).
Typography uses a clean sans-serif throughout with consistent spacing and hierarchy.

requirements.text: Implement basic local SEO for “Mookie’s at Mugford” and coffee searches: set page title/description, Open Graph/Twitter meta tags, semantic headings, and LocalBusiness JSON-LD including name, address, phone, price range, hours (as provided), and rating/review count.

quotes: * SEO optimized for local coffee searches

acceptanceCriteria: The document has a relevant <title> and meta description containing “Mookie’s at Mugford” and “Marblehead, MA”.
Open Graph meta tags are present (title, description, image, url).
A JSON-LD script for a LocalBusiness (or CafeOrCoffeeShop) is included with the provided business fields.
Headings use a single H1 and logical H2/H3 structure for sections.

requirements.text: Ensure performance and accessibility: optimize images (proper sizing and modern formats), lazy-load below-the-fold images, ensure sufficient color contrast, provide alt text for all images, and keep the site fast-loading.
acceptanceCriteria: All images have non-empty alt text appropriate to the visual content.
Below-the-fold images are lazy-loaded.
Largest hero image is compressed and sized appropriately for common viewports.
Keyboard navigation works for CTAs, links, and any modal; focus is trapped in modal while open and returns on close.

requirements.text: Add and use generated static image assets by placing them in frontend/public/assets/generated and referencing them directly from the frontend (do not serve images via the backend).

quotes: Big cozy coffee imagery (lattes, pastries, sunlight through windows)

acceptanceCriteria: All required generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated with the specified filenames.
Hero and menu cards render using these static assets without backend calls.
Build succeeds with correct asset paths and no missing image errors.

constraints: Use English for all user-facing website copy.

Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
Do not add third-party authentication; Internet Identity hooks remain unused unless explicitly requested later.
Keep backend as a single Motoko actor; no additional backend services or external databases.
nonGoals: Implementing a real online ordering/payment workflow (no Stripe or third-party ordering integrations unless explicitly requested later).
Collecting user accounts, logins, or personalization.
A multi-page CMS or admin dashboard for editing menu content.
